content:
Prusa:  my core one, Motor mount, does not have this handy window, which I assume is a later revision of the part

If One of the very first steps was, hey, before taking your printer apart and removing the ability to print any updated motor mounts that will be helpful down the line, double check if your motor mount has a window. If not, print one?

Without that step notifying us of this, and short of the printed part being included with the kit, we find ourselves just hoping it is on there properly
Early CORE Ones do not have the "windows" in the motor mounts.

replies.content: Thank you!  I was wondering where this giant window came from

Yes. Would have been nice to know. I would then have printed those ones before the disassembly. Indeed a window is nice to check.
Once all finished, I will print new ones in case of a future disassembly.
